## Pull Request Description
Please provide a summary of the changes and the related issue(s).

Closes #(issue_number)

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an identified defect)
- [ ] Hardware/Electrical safety enhancement
- [ ] Performance / Non-blocking optimization
- [ ] QA / Documentation update

### Root Cause & Solution Summary
- **Root Cause:**
- **Applied Fix:**
- **Verification Evidence:** (Attach serial logs or oscilloscope screenshots)

### Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project naming conventions and style
- [ ] Tested on physical Arduino Uno / Wokwi virtual simulator
- [ ] Non-blocking execution verified (loop frequency > 10,000 Hz)
- [ ] All QA acceptance criteria satisfied
